title: GAMO USA Corp. Recalls Air Rifles That Can Unexpectedly Fire, Posing Serious Injury Hazard
summary: The scope mount on these rifles can be installed incorrectly, causing the rifle to unexpectedly fire. This poses a serious injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 14.000.

title: Stanley Security Solutions Inc. Announces Recall of Door Handle Locks, Failure Could Lead to Entrapment in an Emergency
summary: The locks can fail and the door cannot be unlocked from the inside, posing an entrapment hazard. This failure could lead to the inability to vacate a location in an emergency. Units: About 25,000.

title: The Land of Nod Recalls Furniture Due to Lead Paint Hazard
summary: Some of the recalled furniture contains paint with high levels of lead. The lead level exceeds that allowed by the federal ban on lead-containing paint, which is designed to protect children who might ingest paint chips or peelings. title: Children's Necklaces Recalled Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 51,600 necklaces.

title: BabySwede LLC Recalls BABYBJÖRN® Feeding Spoons Due to Choking Hazard
summary: After extended use, the soft plastic tip on the feeding spoon can loosen and break off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 33,000.

title: DEWALT Recalls Cordless Reciprocating Saws for Fire Hazard
summary: The switch on these saws can short circuit, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 44,000.

title: DEWALT Recalls Cut-Out Tools Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The cord wire in these units could be damaged internally, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 81,000.

title: Celebrate Express Inc. Recalls Gigantic Gemstone Ring Party Favors Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled rings could contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 194,000.

title: Crown Boiler Co. Recalls Boilers Due to Carbon Monoxide Poisoning Hazard
summary: The boilers can generate excessive levels of carbon monoxide (CO) in the flue gases, posing a risk of CO poisoning. Units: About 400.

title: Lifetime Brands Inc. Recalls Farberware® Fruit Slicer and Corer Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The metal blade can separate from the plastic handle during use, resulting in cuts to consumers' hands and fingers. Units: About 207,000.

title: Wal-Mart Stores Inc. Recalls Christmas Mug Gift Sets
summary: The buttons could detach from the plush characters sold with the mug gift sets, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 70,300 units.

title: Remote-Control Helicopter Toys Recalled Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The helicopter battery can overheat and catch fire, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,600.

title: Nintendo of America Initiates Replacement Program for Wrist Straps Used with Controllers for the Wii Video Game System
summary: If consumers swing the hand-held "Wii Remote" game controllers using excessive force and accidentally let go, the cord connecting the controller to the wrist strap can break, potentially causing the controller to strike bystanders or objects. Units: About 2 million.

title: Pressure Washers and Air Compressors Recalled By DeVilbiss Due to Fracture and Laceration Hazards
summary: The pressure washers and air compressors have pneumatic tires with plastic hubs that can burst, posing a laceration or fracture hazard to consumers. Units: About 620,000 pressure washers and 72,000 air compressors.

title: Square D Recalls Safety Switches Due to Shock or Electrocution Hazard
summary: The safety switch can continue to supply electricity even after being placed in the "OFF" position. This poses the risk of an electric shock or electrocution hazard to consumers. Units: About 27,600.

title: Clarion Recalls Vehicle Navigation and Entertainment System Batteries Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion batteries in these units can melt or overheat, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 2,500.

title: Hobby Lobby Stores Inc. Recalls Christmas Light Sets Due to Shock and Fire Hazards
summary: The lights have undersized wires, which can separate from the plugs and/or the light sockets, posing an electric shock and fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 2.3 million sets.

title: Macy's Recalls Infant Coveralls Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snaps on the legs of the coveralls can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 500.

title: Wal-Mart Recalls Stuffed Christmas Beagles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The red pompoms on the wreath attached to the beagle's mouth could detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 56,000.

title: BRIO Corp. Recalls Bell Rattles for Choking Hazard
summary: The small bell positioned between the wood slats can break and allow access to small parts. This poses a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 5,550.

title: Children's "Powerpuff Girls" Necklaces Recalled Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 48,000.

title: Children's Butterfly Necklaces Recalled by U.S. Toy Co. Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The clasps on the necklaces contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 29.000.

title: Lifetime Brands Inc. Recalls Lemonade Jars For Lead Exposure Hazard
summary: The metal spigot contains lead and is in direct contact with the contents of the lemonade jar. Lemonade and other beverages can cause the lead to leach from the spigot. title: See Kai Run Brand Children's Boots Recalled, Snaps Pose Choking Hazard
summary: Metals snaps on the side closure of the boot can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 6.500.

title: Emerson Electric Co. Recalls Ceiling Fans for Injury Hazard from Falling Blades
summary: The brackets holding the fan blades can break, causing the blade to detach. Falling pieces can hit and injure bystanders. Units: About 4.000.

title: Liberty Mountain Recalls Climbing Harnesses Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The buckles on the harness's leg loops could fail, posing a fall hazard for climbers. Units: About 5.900.

title: Trim Assembly Kits for Recessed Light Fixtures Recalled By Prescolite Inc. Due to Risk of Falling Parts
summary: Heat from the light bulb can cause the fixture’s plastic trim to soften and melt, causing the trim and lens to fall. This can result in laceration injuries to nearby consumers. Units: About 700.

title: Trim Assembly Kits for Recessed Light Fixtures Recalled By Progress Lighting Due To Risk of Falling Parts
summary: Heat from the light bulb can cause the fixture's plastic trim to soften and melt, causing the trim and lens to fall. This can result in laceration injuries to nearby consumers. Units: About 12,800.

title: Regal Lager Inc. Recall to Repair Strollers Due to Abrasion Hazard
summary: Children can touch the rear tires when in the stroller's add-on seat. This can pose an abrasion hazard to children. Units: About 14,300.
